spans.s:
mf. (-रः-री)
1 A thief, a robber, a pilferer.
2 A plant: see चोरपुष्पी.
3 A perfume.
f. (-री)
Stealing, theft.
E.
चोर a thief, affix अण्.

ind.
From theft.
E.
चौर, and तसि for the sign of the fifth case.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stolen, robbed.
E.
चौर, and हृत taken.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Carried off, stolen.
E.
चौर, and अपहृत taken away.

f. (-का)
Theft, robbing.
E.
चोर a thief, वुञ् affix, optionally चोरिका; or चौरी theft, कन् added.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Theft, robbing.
E.
चोर a thief, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Acquired by plunder or robbery.
E.
चौर्य्य, and अर्ज्जित gained.
